title: Highly potent photoinactivation of bacteria using a water soluble, cell permeable, DNA-binding photosensitizer
authors: Elyse M. Digby; Tianyi Ma; Joshua N. Milstein; Andrew A. Beharry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA结合光敏剂Br-DAPI的抗菌光动力疗法，虽涉及DNA结合但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (APDT) employs a photosensitizer, light, and molecular oxygen to treat infectious diseases via oxidative damage, with a low likelihood for the development of resistance. For optimal APDT efficacy, photosensitizers with cationic charges that can permeate bacteria cells and bind intracellular targets are desired to not limit oxidative damage to the outer bacterial structure. Here we report the application of brominated DAPI (Br-DAPI), a water-soluble, DNA-binding photosensitizer for eradication of both gram-negative and gram-positive bacteria (as demonstrated on N99 E. coli and B. subtilis , respectively). We observe intracellular uptake of Br-DAPI, ROS-mediated bacterial cell death via 1- and 2-photon excitation, and selective photocytotoxicity of bacteria over mammalian cells. Photocytotoxicity of both N99 E. coli and B. subtilis occurred at sub-micromolar concentrations (IC 50 = 0.2 μM – 0.4 μM) and low light doses (5-minute irradiation times, 4.5 J cm −2 dose) making it superior to commonly employed APDT phenothiazinium photosensitizers such as methylene blue. Given its high potency and 2-photon excitability, Br-DAPI is a promising novel photosensitizer for in vivo APDT applications.
abstract_zh: Antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (APDT) 利用光敏剂、光和分子氧通过氧化损伤治疗感染性疾病，且产生耐药性的可能性较低。为达到最佳APDT疗效，需要具有阳离子电荷、能渗透细菌细胞并结合细胞内靶点的光敏剂，以避免氧化损伤仅限于细菌外部结构。本文报道了溴化DAPI（Br-DAPI）的应用，这是一种水溶性、DNA结合型光敏剂，用于根除革兰氏阴性菌和革兰氏阳性菌（分别以N99大肠杆菌和枯草芽孢杆菌为例）。我们观察到Br-DAPI的细胞内摄取、通过1-和2-光子激发介导的ROS依赖性细菌细胞死亡，以及细菌相对于哺乳动物细胞的选择性光细胞毒性。N99大肠杆菌和枯草芽孢杆菌的光细胞毒性均发生在亚微摩尔浓度（IC 50 = 0.2 μM – 0.4 μM）和低光剂量（5分钟照射时间，4.5 J cm −2 剂量）下，使其优于常用的APDT吩噻嗪类光敏剂如亚甲蓝。鉴于其高效能和双光子激发特性，Br-DAPI是一种有前景的新型光敏剂，适用于体内APDT应用。
